note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for Iowa's 91st General Assembly (LegiScan 2177, the 2025 and 2026 sessions). Seats are LegiScan's `district` field, read in preference to `role`; the two agree for all 155 members here. The 38 committee-sponsor pseudo-people in the people file (blank district, committee_sponsor set) are excluded, the Maryland shape. 102 of 155 members map to a candidate: 97 proposed by rollcall:legiscan:resolve and accepted after a hand check (94 with the seat agreeing, 3 sitting representatives running for the Senate), plus 5 added by hand. Two of the hand-adds are name forms the proposer cannot reach (a middle name, a legal name against a nickname) and three are members leaving the legislature for a federal or county office that the November 2026 ballot holds for them, the Oregon Drazan precedent. 53 members map to nothing: 25 sit in an even-numbered Senate district, which Iowa does not elect in 2026 (four-year staggered terms), so those are structural and not a coverage gap; the rest carry no November 2026 candidate row in any office in the database. All 100 House seats are on the ballot.
